currentParagraphText: “No. It’s for survival,” the Sovereign answered. “As you’ve no doubt noticed, the Rainbowfeather Songbirds are not exemplary on their own. At least not in C-grade. To make up for our weakness, we had to create a weapon that would make others hesitate to attack us in the first place, as we are fundamentally fragile compared to other monsters. Being a vengeful race has helped tremendously there, to the point it has become part of the Rainbowfeather Songbird Path.”
